description: Use this when the user wants to take a personality test, a Big Five (five-factor, OCEAN) test, or a personality test for self-reflection, students, teens or couples. Shows the 50 public-domain IPIP Big-Five Factor Marker items in an interactive widget (one at a time, progress bar, back button); answers stay in the widget until the user submits, then they are scored with calculate_personality_scores. Also returns the item list and a browser link to take the same test. Does not score anything by itself. Do not use for MBTI/16-type, DISC or Enneagram tests, or to screen job candidates.

name.description: Optional first name or nickname to prefill for the result card, e.g. Alex.

name: show_personality_test
title: Show Big Five personality test
